+def test_format_cursor_data_BoundaryNorm():
+    """Test that format_cursor_data works with BoundaryNorm."""
+    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
+    
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
+    norm = mcolors.BoundaryNorm(np.linspace(-4, 4, 5), 256)
+    X = np.random.randn(10, 10)
+    pc = ax.imshow(X, cmap='RdBu_r', norm=norm)
+    
+    # Test that format_cursor_data doesn't crash with BoundaryNorm
+    data = 0.5
+    result = pc.format_cursor_data(data)
+    assert isinstance(result, str)
+    assert result.startswith('[')
+    assert result.endswith(']')
